post.caption:
Sunflower spiral counts land on Fibonacci numbers because each seed is placed about 137.5 degrees around from the last, and that is the one angle that never lines up with itself. Any simpler fraction of a circle and seeds fall into rows leaving gaps. Same reason pinecones spiral and leaves stagger up a stem. The honest caveat: the golden ratio in art, architecture and human faces is largely retrofitted. The plant maths is real, the Parthenon claim mostly is not.
